content.text:
I updated the organization tabs to use `Frame`, with search inside each frame. The type check showed no errors in these files after formatting. I haven't looked at the result in the browser yet.

One note: `Frame` isn't in CAREUI. It's at `src/components/ui/frame.tsx`, which is the one the referral pages already use, so I used that.

Every tab now has the same layout:
- **Frame header:** search on the left; the title and count (plus any add/link buttons) on the right.
- **Frame panel:** the list itself.
- **Pagination:** below the frame.

Per tab:
- [OrganizationView.tsx](src/pages/Organization/OrganizationView.tsx) – the table sits edge-to-edge in the panel, with its own border and rounded corners removed. Each organization name now has a building icon next to it, as in your screenshot. The empty state is plain text instead of a card.
- [OrganizationFacilities.tsx](src/pages/Organization/OrganizationFacilities.tsx), [OrganizationPatients.tsx](src/pages/Organization/OrganizationPatients.tsx), [OrganizationUsers.tsx](src/pages/Organization/OrganizationUsers.tsx) – the existing card grids moved into the panel, and the empty states are now plain text.

The referrals tab already used `Frame` through `ReferralList`, so I left it unchanged.

Two differences from your screenshot:
- **Column header:** it still says "Administrative unit" rather than "Level". I didn't change the translation key.
- **Count:** it still shows as a heading with a number badge, not plain "1 organization" text.

I can change either if you want.
